timing: Retrospective source replay: the pinned source's 26 fit results were inspected before this plan. The within-array split diagnostic below was fixed before its outputs were calculated.
source_grid: 34,000 saved wrong-key score rows across real and synthetic ciphertext; 26 nonempty (null type, decoder mode) cells; source fits two block-max sizes using 40 seeded shuffles and extrapolates Gumbel maxima/bars at 10^6 and 10^9 trials.
comparison: Replay all 26 source fit fields from the exact saved score rows and compare each non-timing value to archived out_fp_tail.json. No wrong-key beam decodes are rerun.

supplementary_diagnostic.status: new fixed diagnostic, not part of the historical source gate
supplementary_diagnostic.split: Within each source cell in source-file row order, even ordinal scores are training and odd ordinal scores are holdout.
supplementary_diagnostic.fit: Same two-block-size source estimator on training scores, with the source's 40 shuffles/seed 11 and formula.
supplementary_diagnostic.heldout: For block sizes 10, 25, 50, use 80 seeded shuffles with seed 20261023+b on the held-out scores; compare mean held-out block maximum with fitted mu+beta*(ln(b)+Euler gamma).
supplementary_diagnostic.interpretation: An internal split check only at observed block sizes. It cannot validate million- or billion-trial extrapolations or an LP2 cipher hypothesis.

positive_checks: Independent reference implementation of the source's seeded block partitions, fit arithmetic, and Gumbel-bar equation; exact row and fit counts checked. No language-decoder plant is claimed here.
limits: The input score arrays are archived source outputs, not independently regenerated beam searches; tail fitting is model-dependent, and real-ciphertext wrong-key scores are not new plaintext evidence.
